workarounds.symptom: ESLint v9 deprecates .eslintrc.* legacy format. Running 'eslint .' fails with 'ESLint couldn't find an eslint.config.(js|mjs|cjs) file'.
workarounds.workaround: Migrate to flat config 'eslint.config.mjs' exporting an array of configuration objects, or set ESLINT_USE_FLAT_CONFIG=false for legacy projects.
